mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a risk premium adjustment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the identified inflation spike, or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment exceeds 10,000 jobs, indicating labor market strengthening, which precedes a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: No significant positive 60-day forward returns after such employment gains (Granger causality fails, or p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in RSAFS industrial production of at least 2% suggests weakening demand, which predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases by ≥2% in the current month relative to prior month
failure_condition: 20-day test (over 5-day horizon) shows positive returns despite the contraction, or the decline is <2% in practice.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly drop in INDPRO exceeds 5% while HOUST (household spending) rises by at least 2%, indicating supply shock and demand compensation, which drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 5% AND HOUST > previous month + 2%
failure_condition: No significant positive 20-day returns when the supply shock and consumption resilience co-occur (Granger causality rejected).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS remains above 4% for three consecutive months, signaling persistent tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) during the high-rate period.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, reflecting labor market slack, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the rate decline (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden one-month drop in GDPC1 personal spending of at least 4% (vintage date at decision) precedes a negative S&P 500 5-day forward return.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous month - 4% (vintage date at decision)
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the contraction.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent 2% monthly declines in both INDPRO and GDPC1 suggest simultaneous supply and demand softening, which drives negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month - 2% AND GDPC1 < previous month - 2%
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite simultaneous declines in both indicators (Granger causality fails).
